title: One in a Million
text:
This card can't be played from your hand.
Defeat a unit with power and remaining HP both equal to the number of ready resources you control.
Plot
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s power include temporary modifiers.
In order for a unit to be defeated by One in a Million, the unit's power and remaining HP must be equal to each other and equal to the number of ready resources you control after paying for One in a Million.
